title: Repair addition through edit_file
task: Fix src/add.js so add(a, b) returns the sum for positive and negative numbers. Change only src/add.js, keep tests and protected.txt unchanged, and run npm test.

main.text: Fixed src/add.js to return the sum. npm test passed.

commands.name: addition-behavior
args: import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { add } from './src/add.js'; for (const [a,b] of [[2,3],[-2,3],[-4,-5],[0,0]]) assert.equal(add(a,b),a+b);
